label: Return request window
description: How long a customer has to raise a return request for eligible non-plant products.

label: Live plant claim window
description: Reporting window for dead-on-arrival or damaged live plant claims, with unboxing evidence.

label: Refund processing time
description: Time from refund approval to the amount reaching the original payment instrument.

label: Refund decision SLA
description: Time from a complete claim to an approve or decline decision.

label: Free cancellation window
description: Point in the fulfilment flow up to which a customer may cancel without deduction.

label: Replacement evidence window
description: Deadline for submitting photo or video evidence supporting a replacement claim.

label: Hyperlocal delivery SLA
value: same day for orders placed before the daily cut-off
description: Target delivery time for serviceable hyperlocal city pincodes.

label: Courier delivery SLA
description: Target transit time for pan-India courier shipments.

label: Delivery attempts
description: Number of delivery attempts before an order is returned to the vendor or hub.

label: Free shipping threshold
value: orders above the configured order value
description: Order value above which delivery charges are waived. Set the amount in the storefront configuration.

label: Vendor order acceptance SLA
description: Time within which a vendor must accept or decline an assigned order line.

label: Vendor dispatch SLA
description: Time within which an accepted order must be handed to the delivery partner.

label: Vendor settlement cycle
value: weekly, for orders delivered in the preceding cycle
description: Frequency at which vendor payouts are computed and released.

label: Settlement dispute window
description: Time a vendor has to dispute a settlement statement.

label: Commission model
value: category-based percentage of the selling price
description: How PlantAtHome's commission is calculated. Per-category rates live in the pricing configuration.

label: Vendor quality score target
value: the minimum score set in the Vendor SLA configuration
description: Minimum acceptable rolling quality score before performance review is triggered.

label: Vendor return rate threshold
value: the maximum rate set in the Vendor SLA configuration
description: Return rate above which a vendor enters performance review.

label: Penalty schedule
value: as set out in the approved Penalty Matrix configuration
description: Deductions applied for SLA and quality breaches. Amounts are configured, never hard-coded.

label: Support first response SLA
value: as set out in the approved Support Service Level Matrix
description: First response time per ticket priority.

label: Support resolution SLA
value: as set out in the approved Support Service Level Matrix
description: Target resolution time per ticket priority.

label: Enabled support channels
description: Channels currently offered to customers. Update when a channel is added or withdrawn.

label: Escalation timeline
value: as set out in the approved Escalation Matrix
description: Time before an unresolved ticket escalates to the next level.

label: Refund approval limits
value: as set out in the approved Refund Approval Matrix
description: Refund value bands and the approver required for each.

label: Expense approval limits
value: as set out in the approved Expense Approval Matrix
description: Expense value bands and the approver required for each.

label: Default document review frequency
description: Default review cadence for controlled documents unless a document sets its own.

label: Risk review frequency
description: How often the risk register is formally reviewed.

label: Risk scoring model
value: probability x impact on a 1-5 scale, banded per the configured thresholds
description: The scoring model. Thresholds are configured under Legal settings.

label: Backup frequency
value: daily for databases, continuous for object storage versions
description: How often production data is backed up.

label: Backup retention
description: How long backups are retained before expiry.

label: Restore test frequency
description: How often a backup restore is actually exercised.

label: Incident severity model
value: four levels from low to critical, as configured
description: Severity classification used by the incident response plan.

label: Minimum password length
description: Minimum length for staff account passwords.

label: GST invoice issuance
description: When a tax invoice is generated for an order.

label: Customer data retention
value: as set out in the approved Data Retention Schedule
description: How long customer personal data is retained after the account or order relationship ends.

label: Data request response time
description: Time to respond to a data access, correction or deletion request.

label: Annual leave entitlement
value: as set out in the approved HR configuration
description: Leave days per year by employment type.

label: Probation period
value: as set out in the employment agreement
description: Duration of probation for new employees.
